items.title: New statewide lidar study identifies hot spots for California coastal cliff retreat
items.summary: The cliffs that comprise much of California's coastline are constantly being reshaped by rain, waves and other geologic forces. The erosion of cliffs threatens critical infrastructure such as highways, railways, homes, parklands, public access points and more.

items.title: Suicide attempts, ideation spiked significantly among older U.S. adults after COVID-19 pandemic
items.summary: New research from UCLA Health and UC San Diego Health found a significant spike in suicidal thoughts, planning and attempts among older U.S. adults in the years following the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title: Exercise doesn't just strengthen your heart. It rewires it
items.summary: Regular exercise does more than strengthen the heart. New research reveals that it actually reshapes the nerves controlling how the heart functions, and the changes are surprisingly different on the left and right sides of the body.

items.summary: Every shallow-water coral reef ecosystem in Australia faces an extremely high risk of collapse by 2075, driven largely by projected ocean warming, according to a global assessment.

items.title: Storms batter Europe, hitting power supplies, flights and phones
items.summary: Storms battered northern Europe on Sunday, cutting power to more than 150,000 homes, forcing the cancellation of hundreds of flights and silencing phone networks.

items.title: Monarchs report their locations via… cellphone?
items.summary: Who knew a monarch butterfly could borrow a cellphone to check in with friendly people he met on his journey? That is essentially what happens now that new technology has reduced the weight of a radio-pulse tag to less than half a gram (0.02 ounces).

items.title: Milky Way's disk grew 'upside down,' with younger stars forming in ever-thinner layers
items.summary: The Milky Way is home to hundreds of billions of stars arranged in a glorious spiral pattern. But beyond the obvious spiral, our galaxy has other physical characteristics. It's divided into a galactic bulge, a galactic disk and a galactic halo.

items.title: Southern Africa's first known stenciled rock art found hiding in plain sight

All are painted with fine brushstrokes or fingers. One thing this art lacks is stencils.
